findings.passage: HARRISBURG – State Rep. Dallas Kephart (R-Clearfield/Cambria) is shown signing a discharge resolution petition that would require consideration in the House chamber of legislation to place voter ID on the ballot for the voters of Pennsylvania to decide.
findings.note: Release issued by his office (caucus-hosted) with the title 'Kephart Backs Push to Place Voter ID on the Ballot'. Says he signed a discharge petition to force a House floor vote on a voter-ID ballot question. Written in third person, so it is a statement issued for him, not a quote.
